notes.title: Build your own legendary Hero Bot
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42807370/0d171abceda1ddf3e1e9aa813dee509f61389512.png

The choice is yours
Mix and match everything that makes a good Hero Bot, and who knows, maybe it will be your creation that we add to our current Hero Bot roster!

First things first, what are Hero Bots?
For those of you that are new to the game we'll quickly explain the role that Hero Bots play in Race Day Rampage: Hero Bots are AI racers in the game, that provide drops like coins, XP and scrap when beaten in a race by real life players. They can be collected by competing in Scavenger hunt Wednesdays, Super Track Thursdays and during our Grand Prix events. Hero Bots can also be crafted with 1 million scrap.

How to get started
Now that everyone is caught up, it is time to show you how to get started!

In our Discord server you will find 35 pre-made backdrops for your Hero Bot. They will all come with the standard Hero Bot card layout as shown in the pictures below:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42807370/a83d12a720905200554454606d091193d6cf4bb3.jpg {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42807370/588cbb69e8ee02e64075867dcb9dc901407b341b.jpg {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42807370/f1cced0e53f5645e8dd43b3c2f9027ff4071666b.jpg {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42807370/f9470ca3baca9564fc58e050df0c9e990dc1e9c2.jpg {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42807370/62f38b2b78e0dcd6ae09692e14ac3d5fd2276273.jpg {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42807370/59b07426c72b9f9ac5cb30f6d088e3742d6014b4.jpg {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42807370/cb65cdefda09065b17404411798e0baa7a0813b2.jpg {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42807370/f4e496d1dbd33544adb0a56e9eace54427ad9c30.jpg {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42807370/f48af51d363d136956a4bcb3662db440d0fd17bd.jpg {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42807370/5c183c4d0cc9a850e12deb068174a341803f2d78.jpg

Choose and download your favorite Hero Bot card and move on to the next step!
 
Choices, choices and more choices
Now that you have selected a backdrop for your legendary Hero Bot it's officially time to choose what your Hero Bot has to offer. To help you make these very important decisions we have made a list of what you need to build a complete Hero Bot.

The basics:

 Car - Who is your Hero Bot? is it an Eagle, Taxi, Silver or something else?
 Car skin - Choose a variant of the base car you have picked. 
 Name - Every Hero Bot needs a fitting name.
 Nationality - Where is your Hero Bot from?
 Avatar - Which avatar fits your Hero Bot the best?
 Level - Levels may vary from 1 - 60
The drops:

 Coins - Your Hero Bot can drop 10 to a 100 coins.
 XP - Your Hero Bot can drop 15 to 110 XP.
 Scrap - Your Hero Bot can drop a 100 to 550 scrap.
All the drop rates have to vary from 10% - 30%

All the car, skin and avatar assets can be found in the same place as the Hero Bot cards, in the Race Day Rampage Discord server.

Finishing and submitting your Hero Bot
Once you have chosen your Hero Bot's name, nationality, drops, etc. It's time to fill in your Hero Bot card. 

We have made a little template so you can see what goes where!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42807370/6aa48f6e08c2e2681711a74432fb02be1b9af7cc.jpg

As shown in the example the name goes under the avatar followed by the flag of your car's nationality.
The drop rate gets written down in the top left and the amount in the bottom right. 

Writing down the name and drops can be done in any editing program or in the photo editor on your pc or mobile phone. 

Submit your complete Hero Bot design in our Discord server in the designated channel. 
Note that you can only submit one Hero Bot per person!

We are looking forward to seeing all your designs! As always if you have any questions feel free to reach out on Discord or social media.

Enjoy!

NB - This contest runs from 9 AM CET 31/01/24 until 3 PM CET 14/02/24.
Any offensive names or language used for the Hero Bots will not be permitted and will be banned from the contest.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42807370/408e5c9806724d0a457e165c03db30647ab733e3.png

This new season goes above and beyond with new cars, new game modes, new obstacles and so much more! Learn all about the new Hero bots feature which will guarantee more race chaos than ever before. 

New feature: Hero bots!
Hero Bots are unique AI players, which can be unlocked by the Streamer through seasonal achievements. Soon, new ways of unlocking Hero Bots will arrive!
Hero Bots have their own car, player card, and stats and their on-track behavior is more dynamic than regular bots.

All Hero Bots have the ability to drop different items, but they will either drop one item or nothing at all for players who finish a challenge. 

As an example, let’s take Bot Bot Go, the friendly green Wave from Germany, and Dirk Doodle, in their Stroller from Belgium. Both have a 30% chance to drop an item. Bot Bot Go might give you an additional 30xp while Dirk might drop +10 coins.

You can have multiple Hero Bots simultaneously in your challenges - so the chance for more drops will increase! So collect them all, your rewards await!

HERO BOTS

 Unlock random hero bots through the season pass.
 Hero Bots will join your challenges and drop random loot when one of your player finishes - this can be more than one Hero Bot at a time.
 Hero Bots come in all shapes and sizes and can be common, uncommon, rare, epic, or legendary. Depending on rarity they have different drops!
 You can turn Hero bots on or off in the settings at any time.

NEW AND UPDATED GAMEMODES 

 [NEW] Rampage, focuses on most wrecks. It includes traps that will be automatically activated when charged. Players can self-destruct with area damage!
 [NEW] Sandbox, experiment with all the player functionality (boost, charge, explode, shield) in this experimental game mode.
 [UPDATED] Race, which now has traps, disabled charge, and focuses on actual racing.
 [UPDATED] Endurance, the race no longer ends when everyone is wrecked. Traps are always on, no charge is necessary and players can shield themselves.

NEW TRACKBUILDER ASSETS

 New skies, new grounds, new roads, and new wall materials.
